title: drop SP deletes an active sprint whose items are all dropped, bypassing close's ops row and worker cleanup
goal: drop of a sprint that has started (an active sprint whose items are all dropped and whose review story is todo) refuses and names close, which does the record_close ops row and the work/<id> worktree and branch cleanup that drop skips, while a planned sprint drops as now. sprint_leftovers and cmd_drop (_tools/bl_items.py) read the sprint's status for it. Found by the SP-m3azo2y7 review of BG-j7f3dlop.

run: import sys;t=open('_tools/bl_items.py',encoding='utf-8').read();s=t[t.index('def sprint_leftovers'):t.index('def cmd_drop')];sys.exit(0 if 'active' in s or 'planned' in s else 1)

repro_reason: the defect needs a started sprint in a scratch git repo with workers' leftovers; the text check pins that the leftover rule reads the sprint's status

run:
import json, os, re, subprocess, sys, tempfile
T = os.path.abspath("_tools/backlog.py")
r = tempfile.mkdtemp()
env = dict(os.environ, GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t@e.x", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t@e.x")
git = lambda *a: subprocess.run(["git", "-C", r, *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
bl = lambda *a: subprocess.run([sys.executable, T, "--root", r, *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
git("init", "-q", "-b", "main")
open(os.path.join(r, "backlog.json"), "w").write(json.dumps({"item_dir": "items", "lane_module": "", "land_push": ["git", "status"]}))
git("add", "-A"); git("commit", "-q", "-m", "init")
def sprint():
    m = re.search(r"new sprint (SP-[a-z0-9]{8})", bl("new", "sprint", "--title", "S", "--goal", "g").stdout)
    if not m:
        print("check broken: no sprint id"); sys.exit(2)
    return m.group(1)
active = sprint()
bl("answer", active, "start", "--answer", "approve", "--by", "operator")
s = bl("start", active)
git("add", "-A"); git("commit", "-q", "-m", "plan")
p = bl("drop", active, "--why", "planted")
kept = os.path.exists(os.path.join(r, "items", active + ".json"))
planned = sprint()
q = bl("drop", planned, "--why", "planted")
gone = not os.path.exists(os.path.join(r, "items", planned + ".json"))
print("start rc", s.returncode, "| drop of the active sprint rc", p.returncode, "kept", kept, "| drop of the planned sprint rc", q.returncode, "gone", gone)
sys.exit(0 if p.returncode != 0 and kept and q.returncode == 0 and gone else 1)

notes: Merged from ST-5sgru6ls “A planted test proves drop of a sprint takes its research and review stories and refuses while a live or claimed item remains” at the 2026-10-12 draft triage: both come from the SP-m3azo2y7 review and change cmd_drop/sprint_leftovers (_tools/bl_items.py). Its planned suite test (tests.py -k drop_sprint in the land e2e test file) is out under the test policy D-2tq4fhgs, which deleted that file: the fix is proven by its repro and by a drop run on a planned sprint in a temporary git repository (check errors=0, and the refusals on a non-dropped item and on a claimed story).
